description: Source file implementing the ParsedMimeInfo class for parsing and validating MIME type strings related to media, including audio and video codecs, parameters, and transfer IDs.

classes.name: ParsedMimeInfo
classes.description: Class for parsing and validating MIME type strings for media content, extracting codec info, parameters, and transfer IDs.

methods.name: ParsedMimeInfo
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the object with a MIME string and triggers parsing.

methods.name: SetBitrate
methods.description: Sets the bitrate for both audio and video info.

methods.name: ParseMimeInfo
methods.description: Parses the MIME type string to extract media info, validate parameters, and determine validity.

methods.name: ParseAudioInfo
methods.description: Parses audio codec information from a string and associated parameters.

methods.name: ParseVideoInfo
methods.description: Parses video codec information, parameters, and transfer ID from MIME parameters.

methods.name: ResetCodecInfos
methods.description: Resets audio and video codec information to default invalid states.
